settings.returns_body:
How it works

Sixty days from delivery on every club. Contact us before sending anything back. Club returns need approval and photo verification first, and a club sent back without our OK won't be accepted.

Refunds are issued after the club comes back and is inspected. Return shipping is the customer's, and original shipping isn't refunded.

What you can do with it first

Putters may be used during the sixty days, but must come back in brand-new condition: no face marks, sole wear, scratches, dents, chips, bag chatter or grip wear. No regripping, bending, cutting or altering.

Wedges: one wedge per set may be opened and tested, on a turf mat or another non-abrasive surface. Any others stay factory sealed. The tested one must come back with no groove wear, face marks or sole wear.

Hybrids must appear completely unused, with no visible wear and no modifications.

Wear beyond these conditions can mean a partial refund or a declined return.

Read the full refund policy
settings.delivery_body:
Orders leave the warehouse in 1 to 2 business days. Ground delivery takes a few business days after that, and you get a tracking number as soon as the carrier scans it.

You'll see what shipping costs, and how fast it is, at checkout before you pay. Orders of $198 or more ship free.

Where it ships from

Long Beach, California.
settings.p_lede: Forged in darkness, lives in the shadows, and nobody sees it coming until it checks up by the pin. Same forged 1020 steel and micro-grooved face as the gold one, blacked out for the job. It spins like crazy, feels soft, and gives away nothing. Your buddies won't clock it until they're paying up on the bet.

settings.p_d1_b: A forged 1020 carbon steel head with CNC-milled grooves on a micro-grooved, sandblasted face, finished in black with gold accents. The K grind comes in all six lofts.
settings.p_d2_b: One wedge in the loft you picked, on the stock shaft and grip. No headcover, which fits the whole no-witnesses thing.
settings.p_d3_b: Orders leave Long Beach, California in 1 to 2 business days, and the tracking number shows up as soon as the carrier scans it. Every club gets sixty days from delivery. Talk to us before anything ships back, because club returns need our OK and a few photos first. Return shipping's on you.

settings.p_head: Stick it close. Leave no evidence.
settings.p_body: From 100 yards in, this is the one you want. Six lofts from 50 to 60, and a sandblasted face that still grabs when the grass is wet. Your playing partners will describe it later as "that black thing."

settings.p_body: The black runs on the K grind in all six lofts. Want to lay the face wide open? The S lives on the gold.
